headline: Grand Theft Auto VI Launches Globally Following $1.4 Billion in Pre-Orders
summary: Take-Two Interactive launched Grand Theft Auto VI worldwide following a 13-year development gap, generating $1.4 billion in pre-orders. Strong retail and digital commercial sales were reported despite regional regulatory censorship.
why: Take-Two Interactive is a major American video game publisher. The Grand Theft Auto media franchise represents one of the highest-grossing intellectual properties in global entertainment history.

impacts.name: Take-Two Interactive
impacts.why: Generating $1.4 billion in advance pre-orders establishes strong commercial revenue for Take-Two.
